summary: Do not advance the incremental sync watermark when consumed records were dropped for missing primary keys or failed hydration.
reason: Greptile P1 on publish PR #1668: sync --resources deleted (scalar keys) advanced the watermark past records that were never stored, excluding them from all future incremental runs.
validated_outcome: extractFailureTotal > 0 leaves the watermark untouched (SaveSyncProgress path preserves the prior watermark); build/tests pass.
